purpose: Prevent duplicate or racing external social publication when Vâlcea moves from the repository-owned legacy publisher to the site-owned LOCAL NEWS OS vNext Distribution Engine.

direct_publish_steps: Publish eligible Facebook editorial story through Meta Graph API
Publish eligible Instagram editorial story through Meta Graph API
Publish eligible TikTok story through Content Posting API
legacy_writer.repository_state_write: Persist canonical social state and public media conflict-safe
legacy_writer.risk: If legacy and vNext direct apply are simultaneously enabled, the same story/revision may race or duplicate across external channels even though each engine is internally idempotent.

required_preconditions: P16 development/production release separation is CLOSED and provides atomic release/rollback control.
P17 instance bootstrap/second-instance acceptance is CLOSED.
Shadow migration imported legacy Facebook and Instagram delivery history as read-only evidence.
Shadow vNext channel products match the current site publication revision and media selection for representative stories.
Meta credential health is verified through credential references without persisting credential values.
A last-known-good snapshot of facebook_state.json and instagram_state.json is recorded immediately before fencing.
No unresolved legacy direct publish job is in-flight at the cutover boundary.

required_build_change_before_cutover.requirement: Add an explicit fail-closed legacy social writer fence/kill-switch that can disable scheduled/direct apply before vNext direct delivery is enabled, without deleting historical workflow evidence.
acceptable_forms: workflow-level cutover variable checked before all direct apply and repository state write steps
deployment-level workflow disable action executed atomically by the release transaction
forbidden: rely on timing between two independent schedulers
enable vNext direct apply first and disable legacy later
copy credential values into repository configuration

atomic_cutover_sequence: 1. Freeze external social apply for the legacy writer using the verified fence; allow read-only audit only.
2. Read back legacy writer fenced state and verify no in-flight direct publish run remains.
3. Snapshot final legacy Facebook/Instagram delivery history and bind its hashes into the shadow migration receipt.
4. Promote the tested vNext runtime release while keeping vNext direct apply gates false.
5. Verify site-owned story publication, media selection and channel products from the production database.
6. Verify Meta account identity and credential health through references only.
7. Enable exactly one vNext direct channel at a time for a bounded controlled-live story/revision.
8. Require independent provider readback, external object id and remote receipt fingerprint before marking delivery PUBLISHED.
9. Enable the second direct channel only after the first channel passes controlled-live.
10. Keep the legacy writer fenced for the duration of controlled-live and soak; never run both writers concurrently.
rollback_sequence: 1. Disable vNext direct apply gates immediately; do not delete already verified external posts.
2. Roll back the vNext runtime release/database projection only if the release rollback gate requires it.
3. Restore the last-known-good legacy writer only after confirming vNext direct workers are stopped and leases are released.
4. Reconcile delivery ledgers against provider readback before any resumed publication to prevent duplicates.
